import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Fix island label variants (strip spaces, fix typos)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Torgerson': 'Torgersen', 'Bisco': 'Biscoe'})
    
    # Fix sex label variants (case normalization)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.lower()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas from text numbers)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Convert year to numeric
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count penguins by island
    island_counts = df.groupby('island').size().to_dict()
    return island_counts
